Sandbox_HARMONIE_DecayPerDay_tooltip: Reserve points lost per in-game day once a vitamin's banked pause days run out (see the mod's Reserve/Decay/Pause mechanic).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_ReserveGainDivisor_tool: Reserve gained = (percent of daily requirement eaten) / this number. Higher = slower gain from food.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CriticalThreshold_toolt: Reserve value below which a vitamin is considered Critical and starts causing its deficiency effect.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_SufficientThreshold_too: Reserve value a vitamin must climb back up to before a Critical affliction's effect stops (not just leaving Critical).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_EnableCriticalEffects_t: Turn off to track vitamin Reserves without any gameplay penalty for deficiency.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_SymptomReminderHours_to: How often, in game hours, a character with at least one Critical vitamin re-rolls their in-character symptom comment. Lower = comments more often (e.g. 6 = up to 4 times a day).
Sandbox_HARMONIE_SunVitaminD_tooltip: Standing outside in daylight (9:00 to 16:59, no rain) slowly gives vitamin D Reserve, like skin in the sun. Winter months give half.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_SunVitaminDPerHour_tool: Vitamin D Reserve gained per game hour outside in daylight.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_SunVitaminDMaxPerDay_to: The most vitamin D Reserve sunlight can give in one game day. The default 3 is under the daily decay, so food is still needed.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookMinigames_tooltip: Each preparation step of a Cooking-tab dish is a short minigame. Off: every step counts as Good.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookQualityEffect_toolt: How much the preparation quality changes the dish's boredom and unhappiness (Excellent -10 each, Good -4, Poor +5) - times this. 0 turns it off.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookXPMultiplier_toolti: Cooking XP from the preparation steps of a Cooking-tab dish, times this.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBuffs: Cooking tab: buffs from Excellent dishes
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBuffs_tooltip: A dish prepared Excellent gives a buff when eaten (hearty, energized, comfort, calm or fresh, by kind of dish). It lasts (2 + the cook's Cooking level) game hours.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_CookBuffHours_tooltip: How long dish buffs last, times this.
Sandbox_HARMONIE_FoodVitaminMultiplier_t: Every vitamin gained by eating is multiplied by this. 1 = the food's real amount, 5 = five times as much (default). Sunlight and vitamin pills are not affected.
